definition: Held in an approved fallback queue with a named queue owner; no RM yet.
Active assignment to an RM, awaiting acknowledgement.
RM declined with a reason; a new routing decision follows.
A reassignment condition occurred; the current RM remains accountable until a new assignment exists.
Ended because ownership moved to a new assignment.
Ended because the lead reached a terminal status while owned.
Ended because the lead became invalid, merged or withdrawn before work, or the queue entry was replaced.
